findings.title: Assert the feature-disabled exit-code contract for both subcommands
findings.body: The new disabled-feature test only checks stderr for the `metadata` subcommand. It neither asserts the newly documented exit code 4 nor exercises `check`, which has an independently added guard. A regression that prints this same message but exits with 0, 1, or the recreate code would pass while breaking automation that the guide instructs users to drive from the exit code. Add exit-code assertions for both `metadata` and `check` when `rolling-updates` is disabled.

findings.title: Cover the changed recreate-required exit code
findings.body: This PR changes an incompatible compatibility result from exit code 4 to 3, but the incompatible-version tests only assert the error text. Therefore the changed script-facing contract is unverified and a future change could return the feature-disabled or a successful status while these tests still pass. Assert exit code 3 for the incompatible Keycloak and Infinispan metadata cases.
